005package org.wpilib.math.geometry;
006
007import static org.wpilib.units.Units.Meters;
008
009import io.avaje.jsonb.Json;
010import java.util.Collection;
011import java.util.Collections;
012import java.util.Comparator;
013import java.util.Objects;
014import org.wpilib.math.geometry.proto.Pose3dProto;
015import org.wpilib.math.geometry.struct.Pose3dStruct;
016import org.wpilib.math.interpolation.Interpolatable;
017import org.wpilib.math.linalg.MatBuilder;
018import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
019import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N4;
020import org.wpilib.math.util.Nat;
021import org.wpilib.units.measure.Distance;
022import org.wpilib.util.protobuf.ProtobufSerializable;
023import org.wpilib.util.struct.StructSerializable;
024
025/**
026 * Represents a 3D pose containing translational and rotational elements.
027 *
028 * <p>When used as a field-relative pose, the origin is at the center of the field, +X points toward
029 * the blue alliance wall, and +Y points to the left when facing +X. +Z points up, and positive yaw
030 * is counterclockwise viewed from above. A zero rotation faces +X. Poses may also be expressed in
031 * other reference frames; pose operations do not depend on field dimensions.
032 */
033@Json
034public final class Pose3d
035    implements Interpolatable<Pose3d>, ProtobufSerializable, StructSerializable {
036  /**
037   * A preallocated Pose3d representing the origin.
038   *
039   * <p>This exists to avoid allocations for common poses.
040   */
041  public static final Pose3d ZERO = new Pose3d();
042
043  @Json.Property("translation")
044  private final Translation3d m_translation;
045
046  @Json.Property("rotation")
047  private final Rotation3d m_rotation;
048
049  /** Constructs a pose at the origin facing toward the positive X axis. */
050  public Pose3d() {
051    m_translation = Translation3d.ZERO;
052    m_rotation = Rotation3d.ZERO;
053  }
054
055  /**
056   * Constructs a pose with the specified translation and rotation.
057   *
058   * @param translation The translational component of the pose.
059   * @param rotation The rotational component of the pose.
060   */
061  @Json.Creator
062  public Pose3d(Translation3d translation, Rotation3d rotation) {
063    m_translation = translation;
064    m_rotation = rotation;
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Constructs a pose with x, y, and z translations instead of a separate Translation3d.
069   *
070   * @param x The x component of the translational component of the pose.
071   * @param y The y component of the translational component of the pose.
072   * @param z The z component of the translational component of the pose.
073   * @param rotation The rotational component of the pose.
074   */
075  public Pose3d(double x, double y, double z, Rotation3d rotation) {
076    m_translation = new Translation3d(x, y, z);
077    m_rotation = rotation;
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * Constructs a pose with x, y, and z translations instead of a separate Translation3d. The X, Y,
082   * and Z translations will be converted to and tracked as meters.
083   *
084   * @param x The x component of the translational component of the pose.
085   * @param y The y component of the translational component of the pose.
086   * @param z The z component of the translational component of the pose.
087   * @param rotation The rotational component of the pose.
088   */
089  public Pose3d(Distance x, Distance y, Distance z, Rotation3d rotation) {
090    this(x.in(Meters), y.in(Meters), z.in(Meters), rotation);
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Constructs a pose with the specified affine transformation matrix.
095   *
096   * @param matrix The affine transformation matrix.
097   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the affine transformation matrix is invalid.
098   */
099  public Pose3d(Matrix<N4, N4> matrix) {
100    m_translation = new Translation3d(matrix.get(0, 3), matrix.get(1, 3), matrix.get(2, 3));
101    m_rotation = new Rotation3d(matrix.block(3, 3, 0, 0));
102    if (matrix.get(3, 0) != 0.0
103        || matrix.get(3, 1) != 0.0
104        || matrix.get(3, 2) != 0.0
105        || matrix.get(3, 3) != 1.0) {
106      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Affine transformation matrix is invalid");
107    }
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Constructs a 3D pose from a 2D pose in the X-Y plane.
112   *
113   * @param pose The 2D pose.
114   * @see Rotation3d#Rotation3d(Rotation2d)
115   * @see Translation3d#Translation3d(Translation2d)
116   */
117  public Pose3d(Pose2d pose) {
118    m_translation = new Translation3d(pose.getX(), pose.getY(), 0.0);
119    m_rotation = new Rotation3d(0.0, 0.0, pose.getRotation().getRadians());
120  }
121
122  /**
123   * Transforms the pose by the given transformation and returns the new transformed pose. The
124   * transform is applied relative to the pose's frame. Note that this differs from {@link
125   * Pose3d#rotateBy(Rotation3d)}, which is applied relative to the global frame and around the
126   * origin.
127   *
128   * @param other The transform to transform the pose by.
129   * @return The transformed pose.
130   */
131  public Pose3d plus(Transform3d other) {
132    return transformBy(other);
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * Returns the Transform3d that maps the one pose to another.
137   *
138   * @param other The initial pose of the transformation.
139   * @return The transform that maps the other pose to the current pose.
140   */
141  public Transform3d minus(Pose3d other) {
142    final var pose = this.relativeTo(other);
143    return new Transform3d(pose.getTranslation(), pose.getRotation());
144  }
145
146  /**
147   * Returns the translation component of the transformation.
148   *
149   * @return The translational component of the pose.
150   */
151  public Translation3d getTranslation() {
152    return m_translation;
153  }
154
155  /**
156   * Returns the X component of the pose's translation.
157   *
158   * @return The x component of the pose's translation.
159   */
160  public double getX() {
161    return m_translation.getX();
162  }
163
164  /**
165   * Returns the Y component of the pose's translation.
166   *
167   * @return The y component of the pose's translation.
168   */
169  public double getY() {
170    return m_translation.getY();
171  }
172
173  /**
174   * Returns the Z component of the pose's translation.
175   *
176   * @return The z component of the pose's translation.
177   */
178  public double getZ() {
179    return m_translation.getZ();
180  }
181
182  /**
183   * Returns the X component of the pose's translation in a measure.
184   *
185   * @return The x component of the pose's translation in a measure.
186   */
187  public Distance getMeasureX() {
188    return m_translation.getMeasureX();
189  }
190
191  /**
192   * Returns the Y component of the pose's translation in a measure.
193   *
194   * @return The y component of the pose's translation in a measure.
195   */
196  public Distance getMeasureY() {
197    return m_translation.getMeasureY();
198  }
199
200  /**
201   * Returns the Z component of the pose's translation in a measure.
202   *
203   * @return The z component of the pose's translation in a measure.
204   */
205  public Distance getMeasureZ() {
206    return m_translation.getMeasureZ();
207  }
208
209  /**
210   * Returns the rotational component of the transformation.
211   *
212   * @return The rotational component of the pose.
213   */
214  public Rotation3d getRotation() {
215    return m_rotation;
216  }
217
218  /**
219   * Multiplies the current pose by a scalar.
220   *
221   * @param scalar The scalar.
222   * @return The new scaled Pose3d.
223   */
224  public Pose3d times(double scalar) {
225    return new Pose3d(m_translation.times(scalar), m_rotation.times(scalar));
226  }
227
228  /**
229   * Divides the current pose by a scalar.
230   *
231   * @param scalar The scalar.
232   * @return The new scaled Pose3d.
233   */
234  public Pose3d div(double scalar) {
235    return times(1.0 / scalar);
236  }
237
238  /**
239   * Rotates the pose around the origin and returns the new pose.
240   *
241   * @param other The rotation to transform the pose by, which is applied extrinsically (from the
242   *     global frame).
243   * @return The rotated pose.
244   */
245  public Pose3d rotateBy(Rotation3d other) {
246    return new Pose3d(m_translation.rotateBy(other), m_rotation.rotateBy(other));
247  }
248
249  /**
250   * Transforms the pose by the given transformation and returns the new transformed pose. The
251   * transform is applied relative to the pose's frame. Note that this differs from {@link
252   * Pose3d#rotateBy(Rotation3d)}, which is applied relative to the global frame and around the
253   * origin.
254   *
255   * @param other The transform to transform the pose by.
256   * @return The transformed pose.
257   */
258  public Pose3d transformBy(Transform3d other) {
259    // Rotating the transform's rotation by the pose's rotation extrinsically is equivalent to
260    // rotating the pose's rotation by the transform's rotation intrinsically. (We define transforms
261    // as being applied intrinsically.)
262    return new Pose3d(
263        m_translation.plus(other.getTranslation().rotateBy(m_rotation)),
264        other.getRotation().rotateBy(m_rotation));
265  }
266
267  /**
268   * Returns the current pose relative to the given pose.
269   *
270   * <p>This function can often be used for trajectory tracking or pose stabilization algorithms to
271   * get the error between the reference and the current pose.
272   *
273   * @param other The pose that is the origin of the new coordinate frame that the current pose will
274   *     be converted into.
275   * @return The current pose relative to the new origin pose.
276   */
277  public Pose3d relativeTo(Pose3d other) {
278    var transform = new Transform3d(other, this);
279    return new Pose3d(transform.getTranslation(), transform.getRotation());
280  }
281
282  /**
283   * Rotates the current pose around a point in 3D space.
284   *
285   * @param point The point in 3D space to rotate around.
286   * @param rot The rotation to rotate the pose by.
287   * @return The new rotated pose.
288   */
289  public Pose3d rotateAround(Translation3d point, Rotation3d rot) {
290    return new Pose3d(m_translation.rotateAround(point, rot), m_rotation.rotateBy(rot));
291  }
292
293  /**
294   * Returns an affine transformation matrix representation of this pose.
295   *
296   * @return An affine transformation matrix representation of this pose.
297   */
298  public Matrix<N4, N4> toMatrix() {
299    var vec = m_translation.toVector();
300    var mat = m_rotation.toMatrix();
301    return MatBuilder.fill(
302        Nat.N4(),
303        Nat.N4(),
304        mat.get(0, 0),
305        mat.get(0, 1),
306        mat.get(0, 2),
307        vec.get(0),
308        mat.get(1, 0),
309        mat.get(1, 1),
310        mat.get(1, 2),
311        vec.get(1),
312        mat.get(2, 0),
313        mat.get(2, 1),
314        mat.get(2, 2),
315        vec.get(2),
316        0.0,
317        0.0,
318        0.0,
319        1.0);
320  }
321
322  /**
323   * Returns a Pose2d representing this Pose3d projected into the X-Y plane.
324   *
325   * @return A Pose2d representing this Pose3d projected into the X-Y plane.
326   */
327  public Pose2d toPose2d() {
328    return new Pose2d(m_translation.toTranslation2d(), m_rotation.toRotation2d());
329  }
330
331  /**
332   * Returns the nearest Pose3d from a collection of poses. If two or more poses in the collection
333   * have the same distance from this pose, return the one with the closest rotation component.
334   *
335   * @param poses The collection of poses to find the nearest.
336   * @return The nearest Pose3d from the collection.
337   */
338  public Pose3d nearest(Collection<Pose3d> poses) {
339    return Collections.min(
340        poses,
341        Comparator.comparing(
342                (Pose3d other) -> this.getTranslation().getDistance(other.getTranslation()))
343            .thenComparing(
344                (Pose3d other) -> this.getRotation().relativeTo(other.getRotation()).getAngle()));
345  }
346
347  @Override
348  public String toString() {
349    return String.format("Pose3d(%s, %s)", m_translation, m_rotation);
350  }
351
352  /**
353   * Checks equality between this Pose3d and another object.
354   *
355   * @param obj The other object.
356   * @return Whether the two objects are equal or not.
357   */
358  @Override
359  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
360    return obj instanceof Pose3d pose
361        && m_translation.equals(pose.m_translation)
362        && m_rotation.equals(pose.m_rotation);
363  }
364
365  @Override
366  public int hashCode() {
367    return Objects.hash(m_translation, m_rotation);
368  }
369
370  @Override
371  public Pose3d interpolate(Pose3d endValue, double t) {
372    if (t < 0) {
373      return this;
374    } else if (t >= 1) {
375      return endValue;
376    } else {
377      var twist = endValue.minus(this).log();
378      var scaledTwist =
379          new Twist3d(
380              twist.dx * t, twist.dy * t, twist.dz * t, twist.rx * t, twist.ry * t, twist.rz * t);
381      return this.plus(scaledTwist.exp());
382    }
383  }
384
385  /** Pose3d protobuf for serialization. */
386  public static final Pose3dProto proto = new Pose3dProto();
387
388  /** Pose3d struct for serialization. */
389  public static final Pose3dStruct struct = new Pose3dStruct();
390}
